#!/bin/bash
# This script rotates the encryption key used for secure communication in a distributed system every 24 hours.
# It ensures that ongoing communications are not disrupted by using a temporary key during the transition.
# The script is designed to be executed on a cron schedule (e.g., every 24 hours) to maintain security and compliance with best practices.

# Configuration variables
KEY_DIR="/path/to/encryption/keys"
CURRENT_KEY="${KEY_DIR}/current.key"
TEMP_KEY="${KEY_DIR}/temp.key"
ROTATION_INTERVAL=24  # Hours
LOG_FILE="/var/log/encryption_key_rotation.log"

# Function to log messages
log_message() {
    echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') - $1" >> "$LOG_FILE"
}

# Function to generate a new key
generate_key() {

    log_message "Generated new encryption key."
}

# Function to rotate the key
rotate_key() {
    # Backup current key
    cp "$CURRENT_KEY" "$KEY_DIR/backup_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).key"

# Check if the current key exists
if [ ! -f "$CURRENT_KEY" ]; then

# Rotate the key
rotate_key

log_message "Encryption key rotation completed successfully."
exit 0

#!/bin/bash

# Define variables
DIRECTORY="/path/to/protected/directory"
LOG_FILE="/var/log/directory_access.log"
EMAIL="admin@example.com"
SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL="https://hooks.slack.com/services/T00000000/B00000000/XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"

# Function to check if a user has access to the directory
has_access() {
    local user=$(whoami)
    local group=$(id -gn)
    local file_permissions=$(ls -ld "$DIRECTORY" | awk '{print $1}')
    local group_permissions=$(ls -ld "$DIRECTORY" | awk '{print $3}')
    local user_permissions=$(ls -ld "$DIRECTORY" | awk '{print $4}')
    local group_id=$(id -g)
    local user_id=$(id -u)

    # Check if the user has write permissions
    if [[ $file_permissions == *"w"* ]]; then
        return 0
    fi

    # Check if the user is in the group with write permissions
    if [[ $group_permissions == *"w"* ]]; then
        return 0
    fi

    # Check if the user has write permissions for the group
    if [[ $user_permissions == *"w"* ]]; then
        return 0
    fi

    # Check if the user is in the group with write permissions
    if [[ $group_id == $user_id ]]; then
        return 0
    fi

    return 1
}

# Function to send an alert via email
send_email_alert() {
    echo "Unauthorized access attempt to $DIRECTORY" | mail -s "Directory Access Alert" $EMAIL
}

    curl -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' -d '{"text": "Unauthorized access attempt to '$DIRECTORY'"}' $SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL
}

# Main function

#!/bin/bash

# Function to parse packet capture and identify potential threats
function parse_packet_capture() {
    local packet_capture=$1
    local threats=()

    # Use regular expressions to parse the packet capture
    # and identify any suspicious patterns
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        if [[ $line =~ "HTTP/1\.1" ]]; then
            threats+=("HTTP request")
        fi
        if [[ $line =~ "GET /admin" ]]; then
            threats+=("Admin page access")
        fi
        if [[ $line =~ "POST /login" ]]; then
            threats+=("Login attempt")
        fi
    done <<< "$packet_capture"

    echo "${threats[@]}"
}

# Function to perform deeper analysis of each threat
function analyze_threat() {
    local threats=$1
    local severity_scores=()

    for threat in $threats; do

        # and calculate a risk score based on the potential impact of the threat
        case $threat in
            "HTTP request")
                severity_scores+=("low")
                ;;
            "Admin page access")
                severity_scores+=("medium")
                ;;
            "Login attempt")
                severity_scores+=("high")
                ;;
        esac
    done

    echo "${severity_scores[@]}"
}

# Function to send an alert to the appropriate security team
function send_alert() {
    local severity=$1
    local alert_message="Alert: A potential security threat has been detected with severity $severity."

    if [[ $severity == "high" ]]; then
        echo "$alert_message" | mail -s "High Severity Alert" security-team@example.com
    elif [[ $severity == "medium" ]]; then
        echo "$alert_message" | mail -s "Medium Severity Alert" security-team@example.com
    else
        echo "$alert_message" | mail -s "Low Severity Alert" security-team@example.com
    fi
}

# Main function to run the script
function main() {
    local packet_capture=$(cat /var/log/packets.pcap)
    local threats=$(parse_packet_capture "$packet_capture")
    local severity_scores=$(analyze_threat "$threats")

    for i in "${!threats[@]}"; do
        severity=${severity_scores[i]}
        send_alert "$severity"
    done
}

main
